name: verify-email-card
title: Verify email card
description: The check-your-inbox step after sign-up: the address, a shortcut to webmail, a resend that counts down, a typo fix and an optional six-digit code.
docs: email is the address the email went to. It sits in a row of its own, in bold, with a Change email button, under a line that says how long the link works (expiresInHours, default 24). mode is link (the default, it waits for the click) or code, which adds six boxes that check as the last digit is typed: onVerify(code) returns an error message or nothing, a wrong code is announced under the boxes and the first box takes the focus again, and a right one swaps the card to Email verified. onResend is called by the resend button, which starts counting resendAfter seconds (default 30) as the card appears, in tabular figures instead of vanishing; it speaks only when the wait starts, at ten seconds and when it ends, and a rejection shows its message without restarting the wait. onChangeEmail(address) turns the address into a field: return an error message to show under it, or nothing, and the card then shows the new address, hides the shortcuts while the field is open, and starts the wait again; leave it out for no Change email button. mailLinks adds Open Gmail, Open Outlook or Open Yahoo Mail as plain external links, only when the domain of the address belongs to one (pass your own list of { id, label, href, domains }, or false for none; DEFAULT_MAIL_LINKS and mailLinksFor are exported from verify-email-card/mail-links). A short Didn't get it? list covers spam, a typo and waiting a minute. verified flips the card to Email verified for an app that polls, onVerified runs on its Continue button, defaultEditing opens the field for a preview, footer sits under the card, titleAs sets the heading element and labels translates every word.
